Before long the court sent Palace Attendant Bureau chief Yin Shiying and director Gao Tianyou with an autograph edict to Pizhou. Anyong was made Grand Preceptor with ceremonial privileges equal to the Three Excellencies, Grand Councilor, and concurrently supreme commander and minister of the eastern Hebei and Shandong secretariat. He was enfeoffed as Prince of Yan and granted the title "Heroic and Loyal, Quelling Hardship and Preserving Integrity, Faithful Minister." He was given the surname Wanyan, enrolled in the imperial clan register, and renamed Yong'an. He received a gold-plated silver seal, a camel-knob gold seal, a gold tiger tally, a hereditary thousand-household commission, edict and plaque forms, an imperial brush announcement, and blank amnesty documents for Hebei and Shandong, with full discretionary authority. The patent of Princess Peng was entrusted to him to win over Yang Miaozhen.
